findings.message: Explicit experimental rollout flags added in deployment defaults: ai_experimental_tools and ai_beta_features. These control access to experimental AI capabilities.
Environment-based startup feature overrides implemented via CHOYCE_FEATURE_OVERRIDES environment variable. Supports both JSON and CSV parsing for flexibility in different deployment scenarios.
Strict hard-disable enforcement ensures restricted mode flags cannot be force-enabled by overrides. This prevents security bypass via environment variable manipulation.
Robust deployment-mode env parsing aliases for CHOYCE_DEPLOYMENT_MODE added, providing flexible environment configuration options.
Deployment and feature-flag checks converted into ApplicationTest and wired into the application suite (run_application_tests.gd), ensuring proper test coverage.
Full quality gate suite remains green with new coverage included. No regressions introduced by deployment/feature-flag changes.
Backlog.yaml updated to reflect TASK-040 implementation and deployment configuration changes.
